description: Remediates the deferred CLAUDE-AUTH-015 finding: no clear 'this will write files' confirmation panel before source mutation. Backend now declares the canonical PreApplyConfirmationPanelViewModel that the frontend must render, plus a check() function that refuses panels missing canonical_patch_body_hash / diff_hash / verifier_status, missing rollback_snapshot_ref past DRY_RUN, or with authority ambiguity between ui_state and source_mutation_authorized. The 5 distinct ui_states are PREVIEW, DRY_RUN, APPROVED, SOURCE_MUTATION_AUTHORIZED, SOURCE_MUTATION_APPLIED. source_mutation_authorized=True is only valid in the last two; consequence text must include 'source mutation' and 'will write'; training-eligibility text must say training remains False. Panel.training_eligible=True is BLOCKED outright — training never opens through the panel.
